## BRMS for reg

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(brms)
library(dplyr)

# Load data
library(readxl)
Final_Merged_2024_K12_Updated <- read_excel("Final_Merged_2024_K12_Updated.xlsx")

# --- 1. Bayesian Model for 'reg' (Nesting in Schools) ---
df_reg <- Final_Merged_2024_K12_Updated %>%
  mutate(reg = relevel(as.factor(reg), ref = "White_Female"))

brms_reg <- brm(
  formula = is_sped ~ reg + (1 | Schl),
  data = df_reg,
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  chains = 4, 
  cores = 4, 
  iter = 2000,
  backend = "rstan", # Using rstan as a fallback
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  file = "brms_reg_model" # Automatically saves as .rds and reloads if found
)



# --- 3. Calculate Bayesian ICC ---
# For Bernoulli models, latent ICC uses pi^2 / 3 for distribution-specific variance
calc_bayesian_icc <- function(model) {
  # Extract the school-level variance (intercept)
  var_sch <- VarCorr(model)$Schl$sd[1]^2
  var_resid <- (pi^2) / 3
  icc <- var_sch / (var_sch + var_resid)
  return(icc)
}

icc_reg <- calc_bayesian_icc(brms_reg)

# --- Display Results ---
summary(brms_reg)


cat("\n--- ICC Results ---\n")
cat("Bayesian ICC (reg model):", round(icc_reg, 4), "\n")
```


## BRMS for regses

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(brms)

# 1. Ensure the data is perfectly clean
df_regses_final <- Final_Merged_2024_K12_Updated %>%
  filter(!is.na(regses)) %>%
  filter(!regses %in% c("NA_Female_NA", "NA_Male_NA", "NA")) %>%
  mutate(regses = relevel(as.factor(regses), ref = "White_Female_0"))

# 2. Final High-Precision Model Run
# We increase iterations to 5,000 to ensure Bulk ESS > 400 for all parameters
brms_regses_final <- brm(
  formula = is_sped ~ regses + (1 | Schl),
  data = df_regses_final,
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 5000,    # Increased from 2500 to boost ESS
  warmup = 2500,  # Increased warmup for better initial mixing
  backend = "rstan", 
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = 0.99,   # Keep high precision
    max_treedepth = 15
  ),
  file = "brms_regses_final_production" 
)

# 3. Comprehensive Summary
summary(brms_regses_final)

# --- 3. Calculate Bayesian ICC ---
# For Bernoulli models, latent ICC uses pi^2 / 3 for distribution-specific variance
calc_bayesian_icc <- function(brms_regses) {
  # Extract the school-level variance (intercept)
  var_sch <- VarCorr(brms_regses)$Schl$sd[1]^2
  var_resid <- (pi^2) / 3
  icc <- var_sch / (var_sch + var_resid)
  return(icc)
}


icc_regses <- calc_bayesian_icc(brms_regses)


cat("\n--- ICC Results ---\n")
cat("Bayesian ICC (regses model):", round(icc_regses, 4), "\n")
```
